name: Titanium.UI.TabGroup
description:
| Android | iOS |
| ------- | --- |
| ![Android](./tabgroup_android.png) |  |

A tab group can contain one or more [Tab](api:Titanium.UI.Tab) objects, each of which has an
associated tab control that is used to bring it into focus.

Use the [Titanium.UI.createTabGroup](api:Titanium.UI#createTabGroup) method or **`<TabGroup>`** Alloy element to create a tab group
that, in turn, contains one or more `<Tab>` elements.

You can add tabs to the group using [addTab](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup#addTab), and programmatically
switch to a specific tab using [setActiveTab](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup#setActiveTab).

#### Platform Implementation Notes

When using a tab group, note the following differences between platforms:

* The tab group controls are positioned at the top of the display on Android and at the bottom
on iOS.

* On Android, only one tab group may exist at one time. A tab group may be closed to allow a new
one to be opened later, but the root of the application must be a heavyweight window to prevent
it exiting. Tabs cannot be removed from the tab group once added, and tabs cannot be reordered.

* If you use a BottomNavigation on Android with a Material 3 theme you should set `experimental:true`.

* On iOS, more than one tab group may exist, and may be opened and closed as required.
Each tab can contain a stack of windows, and the user can switch between them by tapping the
tab's associated control. Tabs can be removed, and the user may (optionally) be allowed to
reorder tabs.

* On iOS, it is also possible to add tabs by updating the
[tabs](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup#tabs) property, and to switch active tabs by setting the
[active](api:Titanium.UI.Tab#active) property on one of the tabs to `true`. Since these mechanisms
are platform-specific, it is recommended that you use `addTab` and `setActiveTab` instead.

* If you use the iOS-specific mechanisms, it is possible to add multiple active tabs
to a tab group. In this case, the result of which tab is initially selected is undefined.

#### Further Reading

If using tab groups on iOS, see
[iOS UI Element Usage Guidelines](https://developer.apple.com/ios/human-interface-guidelines/bars/tab-bars/).

examples.title: Alloy XML Markup
examples.code:
Default Titanium project as an Alloy view.

``` xml
<Alloy>
    <TabGroup backgroundColor="white" >
        <Tab id="tab1" title="Tab 1" icon="KS_nav_views.png">
            <Window id="win1" title="Tab 1">
                <Label id="label1" color="#999">I am Window 1</Label>
            </Window>
        </Tab>
        <Tab id="tab2" title="Tab 2" icon="KS_nav_views.png">
            <Window id="win2" title="Tab 2">
                <Label id="label2" color="#999">I am Window 2</Label>
            </Window>
        </Tab>
        <!-- Use the Require tag to include external Ti.UI.Tab views -->
    </TabGroup>
</Alloy>
```

properties.name: activeTab
properties.summary: Active tab.

properties.name: activeTabBackgroundImage
properties.summary: Default background image for the active tab.

properties.name: activeTabIconTint
properties.summary: Color applied to active tabs icons, as a color name or hex triplet, where the tab's activeIcon was not defined.
properties.description: For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

deprecated.notes: Deprecated in favor of [Titanium.UI.TabGroup.activeTintColor](Titanium.UI.TabGroup.activeTintColor) or alternatively [Titanium.UI.Tab.activeTintColor](Titanium.UI.Tab.activeTintColor).

properties.name: activeTintColor
properties.summary: The activeTintColor to apply to tabs.
properties.description: This property affects the tint of selected tab icons.

properties.name: activeTitleColor
properties.summary: Defines the color of the title of tab when it's active.
properties.description: The color of the title of the tab when it's active.

properties.name: activity
properties.summary: Reference to the Android Activity object associated with this tab group.
properties.description:
An Activity object is not created until the tab group opens.
Before the tab group opens, `activity` refers to an empty JavaScript object.
You can set properties on this object but cannot invoke any Activity methods on it.
Once the tab group opens, the actual Activity object is created,
using any properties set on the JavaScript object. At this point, you can call methods
on the activity and access any properties that are set when the activity is created.

Prior to Release 3.4.0, you can only set properties on the activity after the tab group
opens.

properties.name: allowUserCustomization
properties.summary:
Allow the user to reorder tabs in the tab group using the **Edit** button on the **More**
tab.
properties.description: Set to `false` to prevent tab reordering.

properties.name: autoTabTitle
properties.summary: If set to `true` it will automatically set the actionbar title to the current tabs window title.

properties.name: barColor
properties.summary: Default navigation bar color (typically for the **More** tab), as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description:
For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

A value of `transparent` results in a semi-opaque black bar style.

properties.name: bottomAccessoryView
properties.summary: View shown as a bottom accessory attached to the tab group.
properties.description:
Adds a custom view as a bottom accessory of the tab group. Available on iOS 26+ only (uses the new iOS tab group accessories).

Note: Label subviews require explicit width and height set to render properly. Be sure to set `width` and `height` on any `Ti.UI.Label` added to this view.

properties.name: editButtonTitle
properties.summary: Title for the edit button on the **More** tab.

properties.name: enabled
properties.summary: Enables or disables the menu in a BottomNavigation. If disabled you can't change to a different tab.

properties.name: exitOnClose
properties.summary:
Boolean value indicating if the application should exit when closing the tab group, whether via Android
back button or the [close](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup#close) method.
properties.description: Starting in 3.4.2 you can set this property at any time. In earlier releases you can only set this as a createTabGroup({...}) option.
properties.default: True if tab group is opened on top of the root activity. False otherwise.

properties.name: experimental
properties.summary:
Only used for a BottomNavigation setup. If set to `true` it will use an optimized BottomNavigation
setup with fixes for Material 3 layouts and new properties: `indicatorColor` and `iconFamily`.
The new BottomNavigation will only load the active Activity and doesn't support `swipeable`.

properties.name: flags
properties.summary: Additional flags to set on the TabGroup.
properties.description: Use [Titanium.UI.Android.STATUS_BAR_LIGHT](api:Titanium.UI.Android#STATUS_BAR_LIGHT) to set the status bar text color to light mode.

properties.name: forceBottomPosition
properties.summary: Force tab bar to bottom position.
properties.description:
A new floating tab bar was introduced in iPadOS 18.
It is displayed without tab icons and at the top of the screen.
This property forces the tab bar to be displayed in the old style with icons and at the bottom of the screen (as on iPhone).

properties.name: interactiveDismissModeEnabled
properties.summary:
A boolean indicating whether or not child windows of this tab group
should have the ability to be swipe-to-closed over the full width of it's window or not.

deprecated.notes: This is handled by the operation system in newer versions of iOS.

properties.name: lazyLoadingEnabled
properties.summary: Lazily opens each tab's root window only when that tab becomes active/selected.
properties.description:
When set to `true`, iOS opens a tab's root [Titanium.UI.Window](api:Titanium.UI.Window) only when that tab is shown.
When set to `false`, iOS preserves the legacy behavior and opens all tabs root window during tab group initialization.
Defaults to `false` for compatibility, but will default to `true` starting with SDK `14.0.0.GA`.

properties.name: minimizeBehavior
properties.summary: Defines the minimize behavior for the tab group, if it is supported.

properties.name: navBarHidden
properties.summary: Hides the action bar (`true`) or shows the action bar (`false`).
properties.description:
Must be set at creation time. The action bar is hidden before the tab group's activity
draws its first frame, unlike calling `hide()` on
[ActionBar](api:Titanium.Android.ActionBar) from the tab group's `open` event, which can
cause the action bar to flash briefly.

properties.name: navTintColor
properties.summary: The tintColor to apply to the navigation bar (typically for the **More** tab).
properties.description: This property is a direct correspondent of the tintColor property of NavigationBar on iOS.

properties.name: paddingBottom
properties.summary: Bottom padding of bottom navigation
properties.description:
When using [TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION) you can set the padding to have
a floating bottom navigation

properties.name: paddingLeft
properties.summary: Left padding of bottom navigation
properties.description:
When using [TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION) you can set the padding to have
a floating bottom navigation

properties.name: paddingRight
properties.summary: Right padding of bottom navigation
properties.description:
When using [TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION) you can set the padding to have
a floating bottom navigation

properties.name: shadowImage
properties.summary: Image of the shadow placed between the tab group and the content area.
properties.description:
The [Titanium.UI.TabGroup.tabsBackgroundImage](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup#tabsBackgroundImage) property must also be set
in order for this to take effect.

properties.name: shiftMode
properties.summary: Determines whether the [TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION) uses shiftMode.
properties.description:
In Android BottomNavigationView uses shiftMode by default. This mode changes
unselected tabs' properties - makes the title invisible and reduces the icon's
dimensions by half.

This property allows the user to choose whether they would use this design
behavior.

Default is 1 (true) to show title only when the tab is selected. Selected tab will be bigger.
Set it to 0 (false) to show all titles and make the buttons the same size.
Set it to 2 hide all titles and make the buttons the same size. Title stays hidden for active tabs.

NOTE: This property only affects TabGroups with the [TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION).

properties.name: smoothScrollOnTabClick
properties.summary: Boolean value indicating if changing pages by tab clicks is animated.
properties.description: If true, when clicking the tab the page transition is animated, false otherwise.

properties.name: statusBarColor
properties.summary: The color of the status bar (top bar) for this window.
properties.description:
Starting with Android 16 (target SDK 36), the status bar is always transparent as part of
edge-to-edge enforcement, and `statusBarColor` is ignored by the system. On Android 16+,
the status bar area will show the TabGroup's `backgroundColor` instead. Use `backgroundColor`
to control the color behind the status bar on Android 16+.

properties.name: style
properties.summary: Property defining which style for the TabGroup to be used.
properties.description:
Since 8.0.0 Titanium has introduce a new style to be used for the TabGroup component.

For backwards compatibility not taking advantage of this property results in using the default style
which is similar to the ActionBar Tabs style but sticking to the Material design Guidelines.

[TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_DEFAULT](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_DEFAULT) is the style that was used in Titanium
prior to 8.0.0.GA. It displays the TabGroup with a list of Tabs at the top of the screen.

[TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION) is a style that displays
the TabGroup with a list of Tabs in a controller at the bottom of the screen. The recommended usage of this
style is for items count between three and five: (https://material.io/design/components/bottom-navigation.html#usage)
In Android it is limited to supporting a maximum number of five tabs.
You can use paddingLeft, paddingRight, paddingBottom to create a floating bottom navigation. If you want to change the
radius or background color you'll need to create `/app/platform/android/res/drawable/titanium_rounded_corners.xml` and set it to
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<shape xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <solid android:color="#FFFFFF" />
    <corners android:radius="7dp" />
</shape>
```

properties.name: swipeable
properties.summary: Boolean value indicating if tab navigation can be done by swipes, in addition to tab clicks.
properties.description:
On Android, the tabs may be selected by swipes, in addition to clicks. This property may be set at
tab group creation, or any time later as long as the tab navigation is not disabled.

properties.name: tabBarVisible
properties.summary: Programmatically shows / hides the bottom tab group of the tab group.
properties.description:
This method also updates iOS 18+ [Elevated Tab Bar on iPad](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/elevating-your-ipad-app-with-a-tab-bar-and-sidebar).
Notes: Animation effect is applied on iOS <= 17, but will be removed in SDK 13.0.0.

properties.name: tabMode
properties.summary: Property defining which tabMode is used for the TabGroup.
properties.description:
Sets the style of the TabGroup tabs.

[TAB_MODE_SCROLLABLE](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TAB_MODE_SCROLLABLE) is the best style for showing long tab titles and
enables horizontal scrolling (default).

[TAB_MODE_FIXED](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TAB_MODE_FIXED) will show all tabs at once.

properties.name: tabs
properties.summary: Tabs managed by the tab group.

properties.name: tabsBackgroundColor
properties.summary: Default background color for inactive tabs, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description:
For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

A tab's [backgroundColor](api:Titanium.UI.Tab#backgroundColor) property takes precedence if set.

This property applies to all states and tabs, not just inactive tabs. Furthermore, the inactive
tab icons without activeIcon will be tinted this color.

properties.name: tabsBackgroundImage
properties.summary: Default background image for tabs.

properties.name: tabsBackgroundSelectedColor
properties.summary: Default background selected color for tabs, as a color name or hex triplet.
properties.description:
For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

This property is only supported by
[TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION](api:Titanium.UI.Android#TABS_STYLE_BOTTOM_NAVIGATION).

A tab's [backgroundFocusedColor](api:Titanium.UI.Tab#backgroundFocusedColor) property takes
precedence if set.

properties.name: tabsTintColor
properties.summary: The tintColor to apply to the tabs.
properties.description:
This property is a direct correspondent of the tintColor property of UITabBar on iOS. This effects the
title and icons rendered in the active tab. When not specified the active icons are tinted with a bright
blue.

deprecated.notes: Deprecated in favor of [Titanium.UI.TabGroup.tintColor](Titanium.UI.TabGroup.tintColor) or alternatively [Titanium.UI.Tab.tintColor](Titanium.UI.Tab.tintColor).

properties.name: tabsTranslucent
properties.summary: A Boolean value that indicates whether the tab group is translucent.
properties.description:
When the value of this property is `true`, the tab group adds a translucent effect to its background
image or tint color. When translucency is enabled, part of the tab group's underlying content is able
to show through, although the amount that shows through depends on the rest of the tab group configuration.
For example, a background image can wholly or partially obscure the background content. Setting this
property to NO causes the tab group to render its bar tint color or background image on top of an opaque backdrop.

The default value of this property is dependent on the configuration of the tab group:
  * The default value is `true` when the tab group does not have a custom background image.
  * The default value is `true` when a custom background image contains any transparency - that is,
    at least one pixel has an alpha value of less than 1.0.
  * The default value is `false` when the custom background image is completely opaque - that is,
    all pixels have an alpha value of 1.0.

properties.name: tintColor
properties.summary: The tintColor to apply to tabs.
properties.description: This property affects the tint of unselected tab icons.

properties.name: title
properties.summary: Title for this tabGroup.

properties.name: titleAttributes
properties.summary: Title text attributes of the window to be applied on the **More** tab.
properties.description: Use this property to specify the color, font and shadow attributes of the title.

properties.name: titleColor
properties.summary: Defines the color of the title of tab when it's inactive.
properties.description: The color of the title of the tab when it's inactive.

properties.name: translucent
properties.summary: Boolean value indicating if the nav bar (typically for the **More** tab), is translucent.
properties.default: true on iOS 7 and above, false otherwise.

properties.name: unselectedItemTintColor
properties.summary:
Unselected items in this tab group will be tinted with this color. Setting this value to null
indicates that the tab group should use its default value instead.
properties.description: For information about color values, see the "Colors" section of [Titanium.UI](api:Titanium.UI).

deprecated.notes: Deprecated in favor of [Titanium.UI.TabGroup.tintColor](Titanium.UI.TabGroup.tintColor) or alternatively [Titanium.UI.Tab.tintColor](Titanium.UI.Tab.tintColor).

properties.name: windowSoftInputMode
properties.summary:
Determines how the tab group is treated when a soft input method (such as a virtual keyboard)
is displayed.
properties.description:
For more information see the official Android API Reference,
[Window.setSoftInputMode](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/Window.html#setSoftInputMode(int)).

methods.name: addTab
methods.summary: Adds a tab to the tab group.

methods.name: close
methods.summary: Closes the tab group and removes it from the UI.

methods.name: disableTabNavigation
methods.summary:
Disable (or re-enable) tab navigation. If tab navigation is disabled, the tabs are hidden and
the last selected tab window is shown.

parameters.name: params
parameters.summary: Boolean to disable tab navigation or dictionary (since 12.1.0).

inlined.name: disableTabOptions
inlined.summary: Dictionary of options for the <Titanium.UI.TabGroup.disableTabOptions> method.

properties.name: animated
properties.summary: Determines whether to use an animated effect to hide/show the navigation bar.

properties.name: enabled
properties.summary: Show or hide the navigation bar.

methods.name: getTabs
methods.summary: Gets all tabs that are managed by the tab group.

methods.name: hideTabBar
methods.summary: Hides the tab group with animation.
methods.description:
This method also updates iOS 18+ [Elevated Tab Bar on iPad](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/elevating-your-ipad-app-with-a-tab-bar-and-sidebar).
To hide tab group without animation, set [tabBarVisible](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup#tabBarVisible) property to `true`.

methods.name: open
methods.summary: Opens the tab group and makes it visible.

methods.name: removeTab
methods.summary: Removes a tab from the tab group.

methods.name: setActiveTab
methods.summary: Selects the currently active tab in a tab group.

parameters.name: indexOrObject
parameters.summary: Index or object of the tab to switch to.

methods.name: showTabBar
methods.summary: Shows the tab group with animation.
methods.description:
This method also updates iOS 18+ [Elevated Tab Bar on iPad](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/uikit/elevating-your-ipad-app-with-a-tab-bar-and-sidebar).
To show tab group without animation, set [tabBarVisible](api:Titanium.UI.TabGroup#tabBarVisible) property to `false`.

events.name: androidback
events.summary: Fired when the back button is pressed by the user.
events.description:
This event is fired when the current tab group's activity detects
a back button press by the user to navigate back.

By default this event would trigger the current activity to be finished
and removed from the task stack. Subscribing to this event with a listener
will prevent the default behavior. To finish the activity from your listener
just call the `close` method of the tab group.

events.name: androidcamera
events.summary: Fired when the Camera button is released.
events.description:
Setting a listener disables the default key handling for this button. To restore
default behavior, remove the listener.

events.name: androidfocus
events.summary: Fired when the Camera button is half-pressed then released.
events.description:
Setting a listener disables the default key handling for this button. To restore
default behavior, remove the listener.

events.name: androidsearch
events.summary: Fired when the Search button is released.
events.description:
Setting a listener disables the default key handling for this button. To restore
default behavior, remove the listener.

events.name: androidvoldown
events.summary: Fired when the volume down button is released.
events.description:
Setting a listener disables the default key handling for this button. To restore
default behavior, remove the listener.

events.name: androidvolup
events.summary: Fired when the volume up button is released.
events.description:
Setting a listener disables the default key handling for this button. To restore
default behavior, remove the listener.

events.name: blur
events.summary:
Fired when this tab group loses focus. On Android, fired when a tab in this tab group
loses focus.
events.description:
On Android, this event also fires before putting the activity in the background
(before the activity enters the pause state).

properties.name: index
properties.summary:
Index of the current active tab. On iOS, a value of `undefined` indicates that the
**More** tab was the active tab.

properties.name: previousIndex
properties.summary:
Index of the previous active tab. On iOS, a value of `undefined` indicates that the
**More** tab was the previous tab.

properties.name: tab
properties.summary: Active tab.

properties.name: previousTab
properties.summary:
Previous active tab. On iOS, a value of `undefined` indicates that the **More** tab was
the previous tab.

events.name: close
events.summary: Fired when the tab group is closed.

events.name: focus
events.summary:
Fired when this tab group gains focus. On Android, fired when a tab in this tab group
gains focus.
events.description:
On Android, this event also fires when the activity enters the foreground
(after the activity enters the resume state).

properties.name: index
properties.summary: Index of the current active tab.

properties.name: previousIndex
properties.summary: Index of the previous active tab.

properties.name: tab
properties.summary: Active tab.

properties.name: previousTab
properties.summary: Previous active tab.

events.summary: Fired when the tab group is opened.
